reason: Original ALFRED files outside the three-year source retention returned 404. Predeclared before any credit performance was observed, after see-only VIX shadow. Do not recut original cohort.
series: ICE HY OAS only, independent economic questions
schedule: Every other Monday anchored 2024-09-02, extending through 2026-06-15 inclusive, 5 and 10 weekday end targets. Resolve from the vintage on the Saturday before the following origin. When next vintage precedes publication of the final weekday level, require that the actual end bar be in an additional vintage 14 days later or has an intervening US federal weekend/market closure; implementation uses the second following origin vintage consistently for all rows to cover release lag.
development: 20 biweekly origins 2024-09-02 through 2025-05-26; minimum 18 available development origins. Freeze C/F identical rules. No borrowing VIX or Q3/Q4 results.
holdout: 2025-06-09 through 2026-06-08 (inclusive), all pre-scheduled origins, scores averaged at origin. 95% bootstrap and exhaustive sign flips on contiguous nonoverlapping adjacent pairs of biweekly origins (four-week blocks). Predeclared Holm over C,F,G. Require at least 12 complete blocks, pHolm<.05, CI lower>0 and both chronological half gains>0 for archival signal. Highly correlated economic regimes and selection of the supplemental horizon for data availability make it exploratory only.
method: Same C/F/G, probabilities, reference, metrics and win/tie rules as base design; no changes based on observed VIX results.
